_meta.purpose: Statutory duty corpus for ANUPALAN. Each entry becomes a row in `statute` (embedded with MiniLM) and seeds an `obligation` per applicable mine.
_meta.honesty_note: Clause TEXT is not verbatim gazette text. Clauses listed in docs/CITATION_MAP.md (migrated, corrected or added on 2026-09-16) are close readings of the cited Gazette provision, shortened for the app. The rest are a faithful paraphrase drawn from the team's domain research brief, with regulation numbers taken only from sources cited in that brief. Before any production claim, check the Gazette wording. A 4B model asked to recall statute from memory invents regulation numbers; this file exists so it never has to.
_meta.migration: 2026-09-16: clauses citing the repealed Mines Act 1952 and the superseded Mines Rules 1955 and Mines Rescue Rules 1985 moved to the OSH Code 2020 and OSH (Central) Rules 2026, CMR Reg. 4 corrected, and 8 duties added from CMR 2017 and the Central Rules. Text for those clauses is drawn from the Gazette provision cited, not paraphrased from the research brief. See docs/CITATION_MAP.md.

clauses.title: Notice of opening a mine
clauses.text: The notice for commencement of any mining operation shall be submitted in the Form and method specified by the Chief Inspector, accompanied by a plan showing the boundaries of the mine and the shafts or openings of the mine.

clauses.title: Sole manager with prescribed qualifications
clauses.text: Every mine shall be under a sole manager who shall have such qualifications as may be prescribed by the Central Government, and the owner or agent of every mine shall appoint a person having such qualifications to be the manager.

clauses.title: Owner and agent responsible for compliance
clauses.text: The owner and agent of every mine shall jointly and severally be responsible for making financial and other provisions and for taking such other steps as may be necessary for compliance with the Code and the rules, regulations, bye-laws and orders made under it relating to mines.

clauses.title: Compliance with an Inspector-cum-Facilitator's notice or order
clauses.text: An Inspector-cum-Facilitator has special powers in respect of mines to issue notices and orders where conditions are dangerous. The employer of the mine may appeal within ten days of receiving the notice or order.

clauses.title: Accident notice and 14-day posting at the mine
clauses.text: When an accident causing loss of life or serious bodily injury, or a dangerous occurrence, happens in or about a mine, notice must be given as the regulation requires, and the owner, agent or manager shall simultaneously exhibit a copy of the notice on a special notice board at the office of the mine for not less than fourteen days.

clauses.title: Statutory registers maintained
clauses.text: Every employer shall maintain an employee register in FORM XIII, an attendance register-cum-muster roll in FORM XIV and a register for wages, overtime and deduction in FORM XV, electronically or otherwise, and preserve them in original for five calendar years from the last entry.

clauses.title: Facilitate inspection by the Inspector-cum-Facilitator
clauses.text: An Inspector-cum-Facilitator may enter any place used as a work place, inspect and examine the establishment, premises, plant and machinery, and inquire into any accident or dangerous occurrence.

clauses.title: Annual returns to the Chief Inspector by 1 February
clauses.text: On or before the 1st day of February in every year, the owner, agent or manager shall submit to the Chief Inspector, the Regional Inspector and the District Magistrate annual returns in respect of the preceding year in the Form and method specified by the Chief Inspector.

clauses.title: Accident notice to DGMS within 24 hours
clauses.text: Notice of an accident causing death or serious bodily injury must reach the authorities within twenty-four hours.

clauses.title: Notifiable occupational disease reported within 3 days
clauses.text: Notifiable occupational diseases must be reported within three days of detection.

clauses.title: Safety Officer appointed where thresholds are met
clauses.text: A Safety Officer is mandatory for underground mines producing above 5,000 tonnes per month, or opencast mines above 20,000 cubic metres per month.

clauses.title: Manager's underground inspection, four times weekly
clauses.text: The manager must personally inspect the underground workings at least four times a week, each visit logged in a bound diary.

clauses.title: Night-shift inspection once a fortnight
clauses.text: At least one of the manager's statutory underground inspections in each fortnight must fall on the night shift.

clauses.title: Serious accident inquiry submitted within 15 days
clauses.text: Serious accidents must be investigated and the findings submitted to the inspectors within fifteen days.

clauses.title: Safety Officer not assigned other work
clauses.text: The Safety Officer's duties are prescribed, with an explicit bar on assigning that officer work other than safety.

clauses.title: Daily main mechanical ventilator check
clauses.text: The Ventilation Officer must check the main mechanical ventilator daily and record the result.

clauses.title: Quarterly fan efficiency determination
clauses.text: Fan efficiency must be determined quarterly and the measurement recorded.

clauses.title: Air sample analysed within 48 hours
clauses.text: Air samples drawn from the workings must be analysed within forty-eight hours of collection.

clauses.title: Overburden dump slope stability check
clauses.text: Overburden dumps must be maintained within safe slope limits, with stability monitored and recorded.

clauses.title: Support and strata observation
clauses.text: Support and strata conditions in the workings must be observed and recorded, with convergence readings taken where strata movement is monitored.

clauses.title: Annual return in FORM-XVII by end of February
clauses.text: Every employer shall send an annual return in FORM-XVII, covering the category of employees, health and welfare facilities and related matters, electronically to the Inspector-cum-Facilitator so as to reach on or before the last day of February following each calendar year.

clauses.title: Initial medical examination before employment
clauses.text: The employer of every mine shall make arrangements for initial medical examination of every person seeking employment in a mine, conducted as per FORM-IX.

clauses.title: Periodical medical examination every year
clauses.text: The employer of every mine shall make arrangements for periodical medical examination of every person employed in a mine annually, conducted as per FORM-IX.

clauses.title: Medical records kept during employment and five years after
clauses.text: All medical examination records of persons employed or to be employed in a mine shall be retained by the manager of the mine so long as the person is employed in the mine and for five years thereafter.

clauses.title: Workmen's Inspectors appointed at 500+ employees
clauses.text: Workmen's Inspectors must be appointed where the mine employs five hundred or more persons. NOTE: the rule this duty came from was superseded on 8 May 2026, and no equivalent provision was found in the OSH Code 2020 or the OSH (Central) Rules 2026. Needs legal review before it is relied on.

clauses.title: Workmen's Inspector site round
clauses.text: The Workmen's Inspector must carry out inspection rounds of the workings and record observations. NOTE: the rule this duty came from was superseded on 8 May 2026, and no equivalent provision was found in the OSH Code 2020 or the OSH (Central) Rules 2026. Needs legal review before it is relied on.

clauses.title: Safety Committee constituted at 500+ workers
clauses.text: Every establishment employing five hundred or more workers shall constitute a Safety Committee of representatives of employers and workers, with a tenure of three years. The Central Government may specify different thresholds for different classes of establishment.

clauses.title: Safety Committee meets at least once a month
clauses.text: The Safety Committee shall meet at least once in every quarter; in the case of mines it shall meet at least once in a month.

clauses.title: Safety Committee recommendations implemented within 15 days
clauses.text: The employer shall, within fifteen days from the date of receipt of the recommendations of the Safety Committee, take action to implement them.

clauses.title: Welfare Officer appointed at 250+ workers
clauses.text: The employer of every mine ordinarily employing between two hundred and fifty and five hundred workers shall appoint at least one welfare officer, with an additional welfare officer where the number of workers exceeds five hundred.

clauses.title: Identity tokens issued and reconciled
clauses.text: Identity tokens must be issued to persons entering the mine and reconciled on exit. NOTE: the rule this duty came from was superseded on 8 May 2026, and no equivalent provision was found in the OSH Code 2020 or the OSH (Central) Rules 2026. Needs legal review before it is relied on.

clauses.title: Employee register in FORM XIII
clauses.text: Every employer shall maintain an employee register in FORM XIII, electronically or otherwise, preserved in original for five calendar years from the last entry.

clauses.title: Attendance register-cum-muster roll in FORM XIV
clauses.text: Every employer shall maintain an attendance register-cum-muster roll in FORM XIV, electronically or otherwise, preserved in original for five calendar years from the last entry.

clauses.title: Accident notice in FORM-XI
clauses.text: Where an accident results in death, the employer shall inform the Inspector-cum-Facilitator forthwith in a notice in FORM-XI and inform the authorities electronically and by telephone. Where an injury prevents work for forty-eight hours or more, FORM-XI must be sent electronically within twelve hours after the forty-eight hours are complete. A dangerous occurrence must be intimated within twelve hours.

clauses.title: Register of accidents and dangerous occurrences in FORM-XIX
clauses.text: The register of accidents and dangerous occurrences required by section 33 of the Code shall be maintained in FORM-XIX.

clauses.title: Register of wages, overtime and deduction in FORM XV
clauses.text: Every employer shall maintain a register for wages, overtime and deduction in FORM XV, electronically or otherwise, preserved in original for five calendar years from the last entry.

clauses.title: Leave with wages record in FORM-XX
clauses.text: The employer shall maintain for every employee a record of leave with wages, electronically or otherwise, in FORM-XX, share it with the employee once a calendar year on demand, and preserve it for five years after the last entry.

clauses.title: Rescue room where no rescue station within 35 km
clauses.text: At every below ground mine where more than 100 persons are ordinarily employed below ground and there is no rescue station within a radius of 35 km, the employer shall establish a rescue room on the surface close to the mine entrance.

clauses.title: Rescue brigade of not less than eighteen at a rescue station
clauses.text: A rescue station shall have a superintendent and at least two instructors, and a rescue brigade of not less than eighteen rescue trained persons shall be maintained.

clauses.title: Rescue trained persons re-examined every twelve months
clauses.text: Every rescue trained person shall be re-examined at least once in every twelve months by a qualified medical practitioner designated by the manager, to the standard in FORM IX.

clauses.title: Rescue trained persons keep up practices and instructions
clauses.text: Rescue trained persons shall undergo practices and receive instructions as specified by the Chief Inspector-cum-Facilitator through general or special order.

clauses.title: Half-yearly EC compliance report — 1 June
clauses.text: Project proponents must file an environmental clearance compliance report by 1 June. The filing is a self-declaration; the portal digitises the paperwork without verifying field conditions.

clauses.title: Half-yearly EC compliance report — 1 December
clauses.text: Project proponents must file an environmental clearance compliance report by 1 December.

clauses.title: Valid Consent to Operate held
clauses.text: Mining is a Red-category activity requiring a valid Consent to Operate from the State Pollution Control Board. CAG Report No. 12 of 2019 found sixteen CIL units operating without valid statutory clearance as at March 2018.

clauses.title: Valid Consent to Establish held
clauses.text: A Consent to Establish must be obtained from the State Pollution Control Board before establishing the operation.

clauses.title: Continuous ambient air quality monitoring operational
clauses.text: Continuous ambient air quality monitoring stations must remain operational. CAG found only 58 of 96 required stations installed across twelve mines, with twelve mines having none despite a mandate in force since November 2009.

clauses.title: Discharged water within BIS limits
clauses.text: Water discharged to water bodies must remain within BIS quality limits. CAG found eight mines exceeding limits, and two MCL mines discharging 62 lakh kilolitres of untreated water between 2013 and 2018.

clauses.title: Stacked topsoil quantity and area recorded
clauses.text: Quantity and area of stacked topsoil must be recorded. CAG found thirteen of twenty-three mines kept no such record.

clauses.title: Biological reclamation target met
clauses.text: Biological reclamation must meet the target set in the environmental clearance. CAG recorded MCL achieving 51.6 per cent of its target.

clauses.title: Operations within the approved mining plan
clauses.text: Mine owners must hold an approved mining plan and operate in accordance with it.

clauses.title: Mineral Conservation and Development Rules complied with
clauses.text: Operations must comply with the Mineral Conservation and Development Rules 2017.

clauses.title: Excavation contained within the sanctioned lease
clauses.text: Excavation must remain within the sanctioned lease boundary. The 2015 amendment raised illegal-mining penalties to five lakh rupees per hectare and imprisonment to five years. Boundary containment is verified geometrically, never by a model.

clauses.title: Safety Officer appointed at 100+ workers
clauses.text: At every mine wherein one hundred or more workers are ordinarily employed, the employer shall appoint a safety officer on a scale of one up to five hundred workers and an additional one for every additional five hundred workers or part thereof, holding the Manager's Certificate of Competency (Coal) specified in sub-rule (2).

clauses.title: Stop operations and evacuate on serious fire danger
clauses.text: The owner, agent and manager of every mine shall ensure that operations are stopped and workers are evacuated to a safe location when there is serious danger due to fire, threatening the safety and health of workers.

clauses.title: Safety management plan: hazards identified and risks assessed
clauses.text: The owner, agent and manager of every mine shall identify the hazards to health and safety of the persons employed at the mine to which they may be exposed while at work, and assess the risks to their health and safety.

clauses.title: Vocational training before employment
clauses.text: The owner or agent of every mine shall ensure that every person to be employed in a mine is, before being employed, imparted training as per the training scheme under these rules.

clauses.title: Refresher training at least once in four years
clauses.text: Every person in employment in a mine shall undergo refresher training at least once in four years, as per the training scheme.

clauses.title: HEMM operator inspects the machine at the start of each shift
clauses.text: Every person authorised to operate heavy earth moving machinery such as a dragline, shovel or excavator shall inspect the machine assigned to him at the beginning of his shift and test its various systems and sub-systems.

clauses.title: Overman in charge of each district on every shift
clauses.text: At every mine, one or more overmen shall be appointed to hold charge of the different districts of the mine on each working shift, unless otherwise specified by the Regional Inspector.

clauses.title: Continuous methane monitoring along gas pipelines
clauses.text: A proper automatic on-line or continuous methane monitoring system fitted with an audio-visual alarm shall be installed along the gas pipelines.
